declared_targets.rationale: Compare output-friendly ownership alone with coordinated input/output ownership; isolate the conversion cost versus store request grouping.
Contrast packed-input/expanded-compute ownership with output-only vec4 ownership; inspect load, unpacking, layout conversion and store instructions separately.
Compare input-only vec1 ownership with coordinated input/paired-compute vec4; retain the original rotary arithmetic, output layout and launch configuration.
Compare Q-only vec1 with coordinated Q/K vec4 input ownership; inspect Q/K handling without changing the in-place rotary operator or trig/output layouts.

declared_targets.cold_rationale: The large strided QKV input plus FP8 outputs exceed H100 L2 capacity; contrast NCU kernel/cache-all isolation with application/cache-none priming. This is not formal timing.
declared_targets.rationale: Change V input ownership alone versus keeping V computation in input ownership; inspect BF16 conversion, FP8 quantization, transpose and store grouping. Q/K are fixed.
Hold vec2 fixed and reverse feature-versus-token ownership of input/compute; output/bias ownership, exact elementwise arithmetic and U-only tuned BT/W/stages remain fixed.
Hold sizePerThread vec2 fixed and redistribute lanes over one versus four heads; inspect token-major loads and HND-strided paged cache stores.

roles: U and G0 are independently profiled controls. Identical Gluon candidates may alias only after exact full-CUBIN, ABI, runtime specialization and launch-resource checks.
selection_basis: Static case/subtype and declared layout intervention only; no candidate timing files are read.
timing_read_policy: This program accepts only a compiler-artifact payload. It never opens timing directories, analysis.json, timing.csv or performance reports.
